recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher/build regression drops ElementDefinition ids, allows duplicate snapshot or differential element ids, or changes the sliceName/id algorithm without keeping ElementDefinition and StructureDefinition guidance aligned.
issue_request: FHIR-12182 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked that every ElementDefinition have a reliable id constructed from the path using pathpart:slicename/reslicename syntax, retained in the inherited id field for URI fragment references, with related slice-name syntax/uniqueness and StructureDefinition differential/snapshot ordering clarifications.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 10018 as the application. In Git this is 35476b4eabc31ac9f28342386aefde59693d436f, '#12182 - more controlled use of ElementDefinition.id', which added the ElementDefinition.id narrative and StructureDefinition ordering notes. A nearby follow-up, 82e1ca4af69d33f527a180c7bfa003e811feb4c0, also named Tasks 12180, 12182, and 12179 and adjusted generator/snapshot behavior around ElementDefinition.id.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active as a datatype and StructureDefinition is active as a resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source says every ElementDefinition SHALL have a populated id, gives the pathpart:slicename/reslicename algorithm, and enforces id existence and uniqueness through StructureDefinition sdf-14, sdf-16, and sdf-17. The companion FHIR-12181 rename to sliceName is reflected in the current source, and later FHIR-13514 reinforced the id-existence/id-uniqueness constraints without reversing FHIR-12182.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the authoritative current source and current CI generated output already carry the requested rules.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published issue renamed ElementDefinition.name to sliceName; current source uses sliceName and retains the syntax/uniqueness guidance relevant to the FHIR-12182 id algorithm.
Later Published issue refined StructureDefinition id existence/uniqueness constraints; it is already represented on the combined branch and supports the current no-change conclusion.
